title: WWII Officer and Family Outside Home, 1944 Vintage Snapshot Photo
subjects: World War II soldier in uniform
description: A classic World War II homefront snapshot dated 1944, featuring an American military officer in service dress uniform standing alongside his family on the front lawn of a suburban house. The group includes several women in 1940s dresses and tailored suits, two young girls in summer dresses, and two men in work shirts. A late-1930s automobile is visible parked in the driveway beside the covered porch. Names are lightly inscribed in cursive across the lower margin.
